THE PRESIDENT 37161

The President
Executive Order 12076 • August 18,1978
Levels IV and V of the Executive Schedule
By the authority vested in me as President by Section 5317 of Title 5 of 
the United States Code, in order to place in level IV of the Executive Schedule 
the positions of Senior Adviser to the Secretary of State and Special Assistant 
to the Special Representative for Trade Negotiations, and in order to codify 
other positions presently placed in levels IV and V of the Executive Schedule, 
it is hereby ordered as follows:

Schedule:
(a) Senior Adviser to the Secretary, Department of State.
(b) Director, United. States Secret Service, Department of the Treasury.
(c) Assistant Secretary (Enforcement and Operations), Department of the 
Treasury.
(d) Adviser to the Secretary and Deputy Secretary of Defense for NATO 
Affairs, Department of Defense.
(e) Assistant to the Secretary for Legislative Affairs, Department of De­
fense.
(f) Assistant Attorney General, United States Attorneys and Trial Advoca­
cy, Department of Justice.
(g) Director of Agricultural Economics, Department of Agriculture.
(h) Director, Office of Congressional and Public Affairs, Department of 
Agriculture.
(i) Chief Economist, Department of Commerce.
(j) Deputy Under Secretary for Regional Affairs, Department of Com­
merce.
(k) Deputy Under Secretary for International Labor Affairs, Department of 
Labor.
(l) Administrator, Health Care Financing Administration, Department of 
Health, Education, and Welfare.
(m) Administrator, Alcohol, Drug Abuse and Mental Health Administra­
tion, Department of Health, Education, and Welfare.
(n) Administrator, Health Services Administration, Department of Health, 
Education, and Welfare.
(o) Administrator, Research and Special Programs Administration, Depart­
ment of Transportation.
(p) Associate Directors (4), Office of Management and Budget, Executive 
Office of the President.
(q) Special Assistant to the Special Representative for Trade Negotiations, 
Office of the Special Representative for Trade Negotiations.
FEDERAL REGISTER, V O L 43, NO. 163— TUESDAY, AUGUST 22, 1978

operative_clauses.judgment_reason: This clause adds section 306 (Development Coordination Committee) to Executive Order No. 10973 and states "there is hereby established a Development Coordination Committee". Executive Order 12163 (signed September 29, 1979; 44 FR 56673) states in section 1-903(a) that the following are revoked: "(1) Executive Order No. 10973 of November 3,1961, as amended;" and in section 1-905 "The provisions of this order shall become effective as of October 1,1979." Its section 1-505 establishes a Development Loan Committee and its section 1-506 a Development Coordination Committee, which are new committees under that order and are not treated as keeping this order in force. Executive Order 11579 section 4(d) (1971) supersedes Executive Order No. 10973 only insofar as provisions conflict; it names no section of this order's insertion and no source shows it extinguished the amendment, so it is not an end.

operative_clauses.judgment_reason: Terminated by Executive Order 12292, signed February 23, 1981 (46 FR 13967, issue of February 25, 1981), which recites the purpose "in order to conform existing Executive Orders to changes resulting from that Act" and whose section 10 states "Sec. 10. The following are hereby revoked:" with item (d) naming Executive Order No. 9932 of February 27, 1948 by number. Section 11 states "This Order shall be effective as of February 15,1981.", so the revocation is recorded as effective 1981-02-15, the stated effective-as-of day; the alternative reading is the signing date 1981-02-23. This clause is paragraph 7 (effective as of September 1, 1947): the statement that the order is effective as of September 1, 1947, which carries no separate command. It depends on this order alone and the revocation is of the whole order by number.
